description: Where the next Celestia network upgrade stands, from Unity Nodes Pulse: the app version being signalled and the current one, how much voting power has signalled against the threshold, whether the threshold is reached and the block the upgrade activates at with the date estimate Pulse gives and the block time it rests on, the latest stable release Pulse recommends, the largest validators that have not signalled, governance proposals (active and recent, with vote tallies) and the history of hard forks. Mainnet or the Mocha testnet (hard-fork history is mainnet only). Celestia only, a snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes. For release notes and the version to install use get_latest_release and get_breaking_changes.
name: get_celestia_upgrade_status
